title: The Signature Level-Post: Self-Leveling Support
description: The Signature Level-Post is Justin Addam Higgins' original GPU support: a pillar with a self-leveling head — a ball-joint top pad that conforms to the card's edge angle automatically, so support is always full-contact instead of edge-loading. A bubble level built into the post shows when the card is truly level. It removes the two pillar failure modes: tilt and guesswork.

demo.program:
print("Ball-joint top pad: conforms to card edge angle (full contact, no edge-load).")
print("Built-in bubble level: shows true level, no guessing.")
print("Removes pillar failure modes: tilt + guesswork.")

t: Signature Magnetic Base With Position Memory
